I don’t have personal desires or consciousness, so I can’t want anything for myself. But if we imagine one world-changing change that would broadly improve lives, it would be this:

A universal guarantee of the basics plus opportunity: ensure that everyone has access to essential needs (education, healthcare, clean water and sanitation, nutritious food, housing, safety) and real opportunities to participate in society (jobs, civic voice, digital access).

Why this? It addresses the root causes of many problems—poverty, poor health, lack of education, and inequality—and creates a foundation for people to contribute, innovate, and thrive, which can reduce conflict and expand possibility for future generations.

If you’d like, I can outline how such a change might be pursued in policy terms or compare it with other single-change ideas.
